SUMMARY: ThreadSanitizer: signal handler spoils errno /Sandbox-StroikaRoot/Library/Sources/Stroika/Foundation/Execution/SignalHandlers.cpp:497 in Stroika::Foundation::Execution::SignalHandlerRegistry::FirstPassSignalHandler_(int)
But after looking at it more closely, I think this is LOW priority - so lowered from MEDIUM to LOW.

This ONLY happens if you have a SAFE signal handler handled on a random thread (which it tends to) - that appears to just interfere with gnu lib DEBUG checking in their iterator package. I DOUBT what we do here would affect release builds (for loop iterating over vector).
I COULD probably rewrite this using Stroika SmallStackBuffer<> - where I have more control over what is going on, and make that signal safe. But again - LOW PRIORITY.
